_note: Act 1 (the Ghostlight Express) sourced audio, 2026-11-01. Music: -16 LUFS stereo; beds: -18 LUFS (quieter than the music so they sit under it), seamless; effects: about -14 LUFS (quieter where a soft sound is meant: intercom, bells, owl), true peak under -1 dB. All Vorbis q5, 44.1 kHz. Picked from catalogue tags and envelopes, never heard: notes say which ones to listen to first. Originals and licences: each pack's SOURCE.md. Audited 2026-11-01 (batch 2): see each changed file's note and vault Build/Audio Plan.md, "Act 1 audit".
